newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria national bank sees dollar at 1.80 marks.
newsitem.headline: Austria national bank sees dollar at 1.80 marks.

text.p: Austrian National Bank General Director Adolf Wala said on Monday he saw the current rise of the dollar against the deutschmark as an adjustment to real consumer spending parity.
"The current development of the dollar/mark is actually an adjustment to real consumer spending parity," Wala told reporters.
"I expect (the dollar/mark) to find its level at 1.80," he added. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
